newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Quad Cities nuke resumes full power.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Quad Cities nuke resumes full power.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 789 megawatt (MW) Quad Cities nuclear power unit 2 resumed full power output over the weekend after a reduction last week for repairs, a company spokesman said.
"We have reached 100 percent power," spokesman Art Massa said Monday.
Power was reduced at the Cordova, Ill. unit late last week after a vacuum problem was discovered on a steam air ejector.
Separately, ComEd has postponed startup of its 1,078 MW LaSalle nuclear power unit 1 until the week of Oct 7, he said.
The Seneca, Ill. unit was shut September 22 for repairs, and startup has been postponed due to additional repair work.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
